The two clusters both center on the nature of human agency and potential, but they diverge on its source: Cluster 7 frames agency as a derivative of external divine guidance, while Cluster 9 frames it as an innate, self-sufficient capacity. Despite this contrast, both affirm that humans possess a fundamental, non-trivial ability to shape identity and outcomes—whether that ability is relational or autonomous. This underlying agreement on the existence and significance of a core human endowment—a purposeful capacity for creation and direction—forms the semantic bridge.

**Conclusion:** Inherent agency
